introduction: 中年失独的女教师吴春霞因未能保护故去女儿，深陷内疚的精神困境，在入职新学校后，遇见了同女儿一样性格内向、拒绝说话的学生方怡然。吴春霞敏感地察觉到方怡然种种异常行为，认定她正遭受校园霸凌，于是暗中观察、试图保护。而方怡然在一头雾水的被关注中，因一只录音笔意外揭开吴春霞的伤疤。直至一场天台的误会，吴春霞发现所有的“异常”都指向自己紧锁心底的关于故去女儿的秘密...Wu Chunxia, a middle-aged teacher who lost her only child, sinks deep into a mental abyss of guilt for her failure to protect her deceased daughter. After joining a new school, she meets Fang Yiran, a student who resembles her daughter in personality—both introverted and reluctant to speak. Sensitively noticing Fang Yiran’s unusual behaviors, Wu Chunxia becomes convinced that the girl is suffering from bullying at school. She begins observing Fang in secret, trying to protect her. Meanwhile, Fang Yiran, confused by the sudden attention, inadvertently uncovers Wu Chunxia’s hidden scars with the help of a voice recorder. Eventually, a misunderstanding on the school rooftop leads Wu Chunxia to realize that all the "unusual signs" point to a long-buried secret about her own daughter, locked deep in her heart...
